properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 5:14PM MDT until August 10 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
SVRBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Logan County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 600 PM MDT.

* At 514 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 8 miles southeast
of Sidney Municipal Airport, or 9 miles southeast of Sidney, moving
southeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Twin Buttes.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 5:14PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 514 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Pueblo West, or 13 miles northwest of Pueblo, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Pinon and Pueblo West.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 5:07PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 507 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Pueblo Reservoir, or 10 miles west of Pueblo, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Pueblo, Pueblo Airport, Pueblo West, Pueblo Reservoir, Salt Creek,
and Blende.
